k01-wind.note: A trained rat sheltering in a chink of the ring wall while the wind blows over the crown.

scene.prompt: Turn [image 1], a rough 3D blockout, into a photorealistic dusk photograph with the same camera and composition, Hellenistic Greece, 3rd century BC. None of its smooth surfaces survive: real limestone, dry-stone, earth, scrub. At dusk in a strong wind, the foot of a small ruined cyclopean dry-stone wall: huge rough stones with dark chinks between them, dry grass and scrub streaming flat in the wind. In one chink sits a single brown rat, tucked in out of the wind, a thin cord knotted round its neck with a tiny bronze tube. It does not move. No people, no fire. Everything sharp.
